map.整理会议纪要时，把多页图片型 PDF 合并为单文档，减少文件数量便于检索。: When tidying meeting minutes, merge multi-page image-based PDFs into a single document to reduce file count and ease retrieval.

map.合并后的页码顺序怎么定？: How is the page order after merging determined?
map.合并顺序就是文件列表从上到下的顺序，序号①②③对应合并后的第 1、2、3 页；用: The merge order is the order of the file list from top to bottom, and labels 1, 2, 3 correspond to merged pages 1, 2, 3; drag or use the move up/down buttons to fine-tune.
map.加密或损坏的 PDF 能合并吗？: Can encrypted or damaged PDFs be merged?
map.加密或损坏的文件会被自动跳过并给出提示，不影响其他正常文件合并；建议先解密或修复: Encrypted or damaged files are skipped automatically with a notice and do not affect the other normal files; decrypt or repair them first before adding.
